project.title: Cooperative workspace process lease
project.goal: Establish crash-safe cooperative runtime exclusion before writers.
project.scope: Bounded R12/R43 foundation; no ledger writes, legacy takeover, IPC, logical identity, company authority or full epic completion.

action.acquire_workspace_lease.description: Acquire and maintain an explicit physical directory process lease without granting write authority.

errors.invalid_root: Reject empty/parent-component lexical root before open.
errors.workspace_busy: Return kernel lock contention without waiting or takeover.
errors.ownership_io: Refuse kernel/stat failure without returning partial capability.

preconditions: Explicit local directory authority; same-host cooperative protocol; no write authorization inferred.
postconditions: At most one cooperative process holds a lease on one physical root.
No source content or lock/metadata files are created or modified.
Drop/process death releases kernel lease; identity loss stays invalid until Drop.
external_effects: Open/read/stat/lock a directory descriptor; retain it until Drop. No ledger/config/network/credential effects.

authorization.rationale: Only physical cooperative lease, never company or writer authority.

idempotency.rationale: Lifetime kernel acquisition has no durable mutation receipt.

boundaries.rationale: Paths, physical identities and platform/filesystem restrictions.

atomicity.rationale: Failed acquisition returns no capability and closes handles.

action.acquire_workspace_lease.behavior: Normalize explicit root, open no-follow directory, inspect filesystem/identity, nonblocking exclusive flock, revalidate root identity, retain private handle; explicit revalidation permanently fails after move/replacement; Drop/crash releases. No PID/metadata takeover and no write authority.

scenario.normal.description: One held lease, no source content changes, subsequent acquisition succeeds.

scenario.then: One held lease, no source content changes, subsequent acquisition succeeds.

scenario.isolation.description: Different roots are independent; unsafe roots refuse without creation; no company/write authority granted.

scenario.then: Different roots are independent; unsafe roots refuse without creation; no company/write authority granted.

scenario.boundary.description: Known qualified host works; unknown/network families and nonqualified platforms refuse.

scenario.given: Qualified development host plus unsupported filesystem/platform classifier fixtures.
scenario.then: Known qualified host works; unknown/network families and nonqualified platforms refuse.

scenario.usage.description: Typed invalid_root or workspace_unavailable, no created files.

scenario.given: Empty input, parent components, trailing symlink/dot variants.
scenario.then: Typed invalid_root or workspace_unavailable, no created files.

scenario.concurrent.description: Exactly one holder; contenders get workspace_busy; stale/PID/metadata edits and ordinary descriptor closes do not grant takeover.

scenario.given: Real Rust and cooperative cross-language processes, same-process duplicate opens and aliases.
scenario.when: Acquire same physical root while held.
scenario.then: Exactly one holder; contenders get workspace_busy; stale/PID/metadata edits and ordinary descriptor closes do not grant takeover.

scenario.atomic.description: No partial capability/file effects; all test children reaped; crash releases only on kernel handle closure.

scenario.given: Kernel/stat admission failure or process killed while holding.
scenario.then: No partial capability/file effects; all test children reaped; crash releases only on kernel handle closure.

scenario.root_changed.description: workspace_changed is sticky, old descriptor stays locked until Drop and no replacement path is treated as the old scope.

scenario.then: workspace_changed is sticky, old descriptor stays locked until Drop and no replacement path is treated as the old scope.

scenario.repeat.description: CLOEXEC permits next holder; no invisible inherited owner after exec.

scenario.given: A held lease with an exec child.
scenario.when: Release holder while exec child remains alive.
scenario.then: CLOEXEC permits next holder; no invisible inherited owner after exec.

scenario.busy.description: Contender gets typed busy without forced takeover.

scenario.given: A live process holds the same physical root.
scenario.then: Return workspace_busy with no capability, no wait and no filesystem content effects.
